en.md: ## 2.3 Island Partition

gemini.md: ## 2.3 島內分割

en.md: ### Definition

gemini.md: ### 定義（Definition）

en.md: Island Partition is the compound worst case on the disruption ladder: the north–south domestic long-haul trunks are severed, so that northern Taiwan cannot reach southern Taiwan, and global connectivity is fully lost at the same time. By escalation inclusion, every effect of Global Cutoff carries forward at full intensity: complete cessation of international traffic, DNS cache decay for non-.tw names, protocol-clock depletion, and hard-edge traffic-plane failure. The brownout effects of 50% Degradation are subsumed and exceeded, and the domestic split is added on top of the global loss.

gemini.md: 島內分割是中斷階梯上的複合最壞情境：南北向國內長途幹線遭到切斷，導致台灣北部無法連至台灣南部，同時全球連線能力完全喪失。依據升級包含性質，全球斷線的所有影響都會以完整強度延續：國際流量完全停止、非 .tw 名稱的 DNS 快取衰退、協定時鐘耗盡，以及硬性的流量平面失效。50% 降載的降質影響已被涵蓋並超越，且在全球中斷之上更疊加了國內網路的分割。

en.md: Each geographic half therefore forms an internally connected network that can reach no other network, domestic or international. The definition requires both total global loss and total north–south severance. A partition in which some global access survives falls outside it and is analyzed only as the simulated scenario Partial-Access Partition.

gemini.md: 因此，每個地理半區各自形成一個內部相連、但無法觸及任何其他國內或國際網路的網路。本定義要求同時滿足全球連線完全喪失與南北完全切斷。若有部分全球存取能力存活的分割，則不屬於此定義，僅作為模擬情境「部分連外分割」進行分析。

en.md: ### Failure texture

gemini.md: ### 失效樣貌（Failure texture）

en.md: Within each half the domestic network runs at its pre-event baseline, while across the partition boundary it fails completely. Inside a half, latency and packet loss are normal and services hosted in the same half are fully reachable. Across the boundary, the failure is hard unreachability rather than degradation: a service in the opposite half is unreachable by the same mechanism as any foreign-hosted service under Global Cutoff. The TCP SYN receives no reply, and the connection attempt ends at the operating system's timeout instead of failing fast or completing slowly.

gemini.md: 在每個半區內部，國內網路皆維持在事件發生前的基準運作，但跨越分割邊界時則完全失效。半區內部延遲與封包遺失均屬正常，託管於同一半區的服務完全可達。跨越邊界時，失效型態是硬性的不可達，而非降質：位於對側半區的服務不可達，其機制與全球斷線下任何國外託管的服務完全相同。TCP SYN 接收不到回應，連線嘗試會在作業系統的逾時時間結束，而非快速失敗或緩慢完成。

en.md: This cross-partition failure separates Island Partition from both lower rungs. Under 50% Degradation, cross-island traffic is degraded but non-zero; under Global Cutoff, the domestic network is fully operational. Under Island Partition, cross-partition domestic traffic is as unreachable as international traffic.

gemini.md: 這種跨分割區失效將島內分割與較低的兩個梯級區分開來。在 50% 降載下，跨島流量雖有降質但非零；在全球斷線下，國內網路完全正常運作。而在島內分割下，跨分割區的國內流量與國際流量一樣不可達。

en.md: The primary available analog at sub-national scale is the occupied-territory routing of Kherson, Ukraine, in 2022–2024 (§2.1, Compromised Transit): after Russian forces coerced KhersonTelecom (AS47598) onto Crimean upstreams in May 2022, route-collector data showed the city's isolation from Ukrainian networks ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)), and RIPE Labs measured the matching reversal in latency direction ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: 次國家規模下主要的可用類比，是 2022 至 2024 年烏克蘭赫爾松（Kherson）佔領區的路由狀況（§2.1，轉接遭挾持）：2022 年 5 月俄羅斯軍隊脅迫 KhersonTelecom（AS47598）改走克里米亞上游後，路由收集器資料顯示該市與烏克蘭網路隔離（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)），而 RIPE Labs 也測得相應的延遲方向反轉（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: Kherson is a structural analog, not a direct precedent. It occurred at sub-national scale, and the non-occupied parts of Ukraine kept their global connectivity. No comparable real-world event documents the pattern that Island Partition requires: a partition at island scale combined with a simultaneous global cutoff.

gemini.md: 赫爾松是結構上的類比，而非直接前例。它發生於次國家規模，且烏克蘭未遭佔領的區域仍保持全球連線。現有真實世界事件中，並無任何可相比擬的案例記錄了島內分割所要求的型態：全島規模的分割加上同時發生的全球斷線。

en.md: ### Time texture

gemini.md: ### 時間樣貌（Time texture）

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* The partition appears in the routing plane within minutes of trunk severance, as cross-partition BGP prefixes are withdrawn or black-holed.

gemini.md: *(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 當跨分割區的 BGP 前綴被撤回或遭黑洞化時，分割狀況會在幹線切斷後的數分鐘內顯現於路由平面。

en.md: At Kherson, a city-wide outage on April 30, 2022 was followed on May 1 by the first network's return through the Crimean provider, and after a further outage on May 30 Kherson ISPs lost their links to other Ukrainian networks, "possibly for good"; within a few days every network in the city was either offline or connected through the Crimean provider ([Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* A crystallization window of comparable, days-long scale is the operative planning assumption for a Taiwan partition.

gemini.md: 在赫爾松，2022 年 4 月 30 日全市大斷網後，5 月 1 日首個網路透過克里米亞業者恢復連線；在 5 月 30 日進一步斷網後，赫爾松的 ISP 失去了與烏克蘭其他網路的連結，「可能再也無法恢復」；幾天之內，全市所有網路要麼離線，要麼透過克里米亞業者連線（[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。*(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 長達數日、具可比性規模的固定化視窗，是台灣發生分割時的可行規劃假設。

en.md: *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Global Cutoff escalation-inclusion property)* In the first Phase, from hours to days after onset, the Global Cutoff processes run in both halves at once: applications whose servers sit in the opposite half show the Global Cutoff timeout signature, DNS caches for cross-partition and off-island names decay as TTLs expire with no re-fill path, and the protocol-clock depletion already under way (TLS certificate renewal windows, OCSP stapling refresh, DNSSEC RRSIG validity periods) compounds toward the deferred-failure wave described under Protocol-Clock Cascade.

gemini.md: *(依據島內分割梯級定義與全球斷線升級包含性質所做的結構性推論)* 在第一階段（發生後數小時至數天），全球斷線的運作過程會在南北兩個半區同時展開：伺服器位於對側半區的應用程式展現出全球斷線的逾時特徵；跨分割區與島外名稱的 DNS 快取隨著 TTL 到期且無重新填補路徑而衰退；而已經展開的協定時鐘耗盡（TLS 憑證更新視窗、OCSP 裝訂重新整理、DNSSEC RRSIG 有效期限）則會複合加劇，趨向協定時鐘連鎖失效中所述的延遲失效浪潮。

en.md: *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* In a second Phase, a partition maintained by forced rerouting remains sensitive to secondary disruption along the coerced upstream. Downstream of Kherson's forced rerouting, damage to the Kerch Strait Bridge cable in October 2022 raised latency to UMLC-dependent networks by a documented 5–10 ms ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: *(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 在第二階段，透過強制重導向維持的分割，對被脅迫上游沿線的二次中斷依然敏感。在赫爾松強制重導向的下游，2022 年 10 月刻赤海峽大橋（Kerch Strait Bridge）海纜受損，使依賴 UMLC 的網路延遲據記錄增加了 5–10 ms（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: ### Recognition signatures

gemini.md: ### 辨識特徵（Recognition signatures）

en.md: **BGP and routing plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* At onset, cross-partition prefixes are withdrawn or black-holed while prefixes within each half stay announced and stable, so a BGP monitor or route collector observing from inside either half records no withdrawal events, and external route collectors see cross-partition ASNs become unreachable from each side in AS-path data. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Kentik Kherson routing documentation cited above)* Where the partition is produced by forced rerouting rather than route withdrawal, AS-path geometry changes detectably, with prefixes from one half announced via a new upstream AS within days of onset, as at Kherson (§2.1, Compromised Transit; [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)). *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* The absence of cross-partition withdrawals together with a new upstream AS path on one side is therefore the routing-plane signature of a forced-rerouting partition, in which physical connectivity survives but transits an adversary upstream, as against a route-withdrawal partition, in which the cross-partition paths disappear from the routing table.

gemini.md: **BGP 與路由平面。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 在發生初期，跨分割區的前綴會被撤回或遭黑洞化，而各半區內部的前綴則保持宣告且穩定，因此從任一半區內部觀測的 BGP 監測器或路由收集器不會記錄到任何撤回事件，外部路由收集器則會在 AS 路徑資料中觀察到跨分割區的 ASN 從兩側皆變為不可達。*(依據島內分割梯級定義與上文引用的 Kentik Kherson 路由文件所做的結構性推論)* 若分割是由強制重導向而非路由撤回造成，AS 路徑拓撲會出現可偵測的變化：如赫爾松案例所示，其中一個半區的前綴會在發生後數天內透過新的上游 AS 宣告（§2.1，轉接遭挾持；[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/)）。*(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 因此，缺乏跨分割區撤回訊息並在單側出現新的上游 AS 路徑，是強制重導向分割在路由平面的特徵——此時實體連線雖存活但轉接至敵對者上游；相較之下，在路由撤回分割中，跨分割區路徑則會直接從路由表中消失。

en.md: **Traffic plane.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* Traffic volume and loss rate within each half stay at the pre-event baseline, and cross-partition traffic is zero rather than lossy, failing by timeout as international traffic does under Global Cutoff. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* A RIPE Atlas probe in the northern half reaches northern-half services at baseline latency and times out on all southern-half and international destinations, and a probe in the southern half shows the mirror image. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* This bidirectional split, with normal traffic inside each half, is the definitive telemetry signature distinguishing Island Partition from Global Cutoff, under which probes anywhere on the island see zero outbound connectivity while domestic traffic flows across the whole island. *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* Because both halves have lost global access, Cloudflare Radar aggregate traffic under baseline Island Partition shows a near-zero profile similar to the Global Cutoff cliff, and separating the two rungs on Cloudflare Radar requires city-level data in which some cities show domestic traffic at baseline alongside zero international traffic, a pattern absent under Global Cutoff, where all cities show near-zero outbound traffic.

gemini.md: **流量平面。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 各半區內部的流量與遺失率均維持在事件發生前的基準，而跨分割區流量則是歸零而非高遺失率，並像全球斷線下的國際流量一樣因逾時而失敗。*(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 位於北半區的 RIPE Atlas 探針能以基準延遲連至北半區服務，但連至所有南半區與國際目的地都會逾時；位於南半區的探針則呈現完全鏡像的結果。*(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 這種雙向分割、且各半區內部流量正常的現象，是將島內分割與全球斷線區分開來的關鍵遙測特徵；在全球斷線下，全島任何位置的探針都會觀察到對外連線歸零，但國內流量能在全島正常流動。*(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 由於兩個半區皆已失去全球存取能力，基準島內分割下的 Cloudflare Radar 總體流量會呈現類似全球斷線斷崖的近乎歸零輪廓；若要在 Cloudflare Radar 上區分這兩個梯級，需要依靠縣市層級的資料——其中部分縣市在國際流量歸零的同時，國內流量仍維持在基準值，這種模式在全球斷線下並不成立（在全球斷線下所有縣市的對外流量皆近乎歸零）。

en.md: **DNS and cache behavior.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Global Cutoff escalation-inclusion property)* Within each half, resolution of off-island and cross-partition names follows the Global Cutoff pattern: caches decay as TTLs expire with no re-fill path, and SERVFAIL is returned for any name whose authoritative server is off-island or in the opposite half. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* For a .tw zone whose primary authoritative nameservers sit in the opposite half, secondary nameservers in the near half are the only mechanism that prevents split-brain SERVFAIL, and without them the connectivity failure becomes a name-resolution failure for users in the near half even when the domain's web servers are in that half and operational.

gemini.md: **DNS 與快取行為。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義與全球斷線升級包含性質所做的結構性推論)* 在每個半區內部，島外與跨分割區名稱的解析遵循全球斷線的模式：快取隨著 TTL 到期且無重新填補路徑而衰退，任何權威伺服器位於島外或對側半區的名稱都會傳回 SERVFAIL。*(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 對於主要權威名稱伺服器位於對側半區的 .tw 區域而言，近端半區的次要名稱伺服器是防止腦裂 SERVFAIL 的唯一機制；若缺乏次要名稱伺服器，即使該網域的 Web 伺服器位於近端半區且運作正常，對近端半區的使用者而言，連線失敗也會轉變成名稱解析失敗。

en.md: **Recovery path.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition)* Recovery requires two failure conditions to be resolved independently, trunk severance on a physical engineering repair timeline and global connectivity loss on a cable-repair or administrative-reversal timeline, and because neither resolves the other, the longest timeline bounds restoration, which gives Island Partition the compound worst-case recovery on the ladder. *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* Where the partition is maintained by forced rerouting, restoring the pre-partition path requires removal of the coercive external condition, a political or military event rather than a cable splice: at Kherson, latency returned to pre-partition levels "pretty quickly" once liberation on November 11, 2022 removed the coercion, consistent with routing returning to its pre-partition geometry as soon as the AS-path coercion ended ([RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)).

gemini.md: **復原路徑。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 復原需要獨立解決兩項失效條件：幹線切斷需依循實體工程修復時程，全球連線喪失則需依循海纜修復或行政決策逆轉時程；由於兩者互不相干，復原時間受限於最長的時間軸，這使得島內分割具備階梯上最複雜的最壞情況復原時程。*(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 若分割是由強制重導向維持，恢復分割前的路徑需要解除外部脅迫條件，這屬於政治或軍事事件，而非海纜接續工程：在赫爾松，2022 年 11 月 11 日光復並解除脅迫後，延遲「相當迅速」地恢復至分割前的水準，這與 AS 路徑脅迫一結束路由即恢復至分割前的拓撲結構相符（[RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/)）。

en.md: **Discriminators within the rung.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Partial-Access Partition simulated-scenario definition)* Partial-Access Partition departs from the baseline on traffic volume and geographic distribution: where the baseline shows near-zero aggregate traffic from both halves on Cloudflare Radar and IODA active probing, Partial-Access Partition shows a step-down rather than a cliff, and residual traffic from one half gives city-level data an asymmetric geographic profile. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Single-City Isolation simulated-scenario definition)* Single-City Isolation departs on the geographic scope of the traffic-plane failure: under the baseline, RIPE Atlas probes anywhere in either half show zero cross-partition and zero international reachability, whereas under Single-City Isolation probes outside the isolated city show no partition anomaly and a probe inside it reaches no out-of-city destination. *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Site-Level Blackout simulated-scenario definition)* Site-Level Blackout produces no BGP routing-plane signal and requires no island-wide routing event: a site without upstream connectivity does not participate in the routing table, is indistinguishable in measurement from a powered-off network segment, and shows no split-reachability profile, so its absence from active-probing responses is the only external indicator.

gemini.md: **梯級內的區分因素。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義與部分連外分割模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 部分連外分割在流量與地理分布上偏離基準：基準情況下 Cloudflare Radar 與 IODA 主動探測顯示兩個半區的總體流量皆近乎歸零，而部分連外分割則呈現階梯式下降而非斷崖，且來自其中一個半區的殘餘流量使縣市層級資料展現非對稱的地理輪廓。*(依據島內分割梯級定義與單城孤立模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 單城孤立在流量平面失效的地理範圍上有所偏離：在基準情況下，位於任一半區任何位置的 RIPE Atlas 探針皆顯示跨分割區與國際可達性歸零；而在單城孤立下，孤立城市之外的探針未顯示任何分割異常，城市內部的探針則無法觸及任何城外目的地。*(依據島內分割梯級定義與站點全斷模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 站點全斷不會產生任何 BGP 路由平面訊號，也不需要全島規模的路由事件：缺乏上游連線的站點不會參與路由表，在量測上與已關機的網段無異，且不會展現分割可達性輪廓，因此在主動探測回應中消失是唯一的外部指標。

en.md: ### Simulated scenarios

gemini.md: ### 模擬情境（Simulated scenarios）

en.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

gemini.md: #### Partial-Access Partition

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: the north–south domestic trunks are severed and global connectivity is largely lost, but one geographic half retains a surviving international cable path that provides limited global egress to that half only, while the other half has none.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：南北向國內幹線遭切斷，全球連線能力大體喪失，但其中一個地理半區仍保有一條存活的國際海纜路徑，僅為該半區提供有限的全球連外出口，而另一個半區則完全沒有。

en.md: **Narrative shape.** The two halves fail asymmetrically. The half without surviving cable access follows the Island Partition baseline, with no cross-partition domestic reachability and no global egress. In the other half, a surviving cable landing station in one geographic cluster, such as the southern cluster at Fangshan (枋山), provides a trickle of global bandwidth. *(Structural inference from the k1, k2, and k3 gateway-kind descriptions in §3.2.1 and the Island Partition rung definition)* Whether that trickle is usable depends on the failure kind of the gateway serving it:

gemini.md: **情節輪廓。** 兩個半區呈現非對稱失效。缺乏存活海纜連線的半區遵循島內分割基準，既無跨分割區國內可達性，也無全球連外出口。在另一個半區，位於單一地理群集（如枋山南部群集）的倖存海纜登陸站提供些許全球頻寬涓流。*(依據 §3.2.1 中 k1、k2 與 k3 閘道類型的說明及島內分割梯級定義所做的結構性推論)* 該涓流是否可用，取決於為其提供服務的閘道失效類型：

en.md:
| Gateway kind (§3.2.1) | Global egress of the surviving half |
|---|---|
| k1, administrative shutdown | None in practice: the gateway blocks all egress regardless of the physical path traffic arrives on, so the circuit's physical survival is operationally irrelevant |
| k2, throughput ceiling | Brownout-textured: an administrative throttle on general civilian traffic gives the surviving half something closer to the 50% Degradation failure texture on the international axis, while the other half has no global egress |
| k3, forced rerouting | Traffic flows but transits adversary-controlled infrastructure, which exposes the half's international communications to content inspection and forced path selection |

gemini.md:
| 閘道類型（§3.2.1） | 倖存半區的全球連外出口 |
|---|---|
| k1，行政關閉 | 實務上無：無論流量透過何種實體路徑到達，閘道都會封鎖所有連外出口，因此電路的實體倖存於維運上無關緊要 |
| k2，傳輸量上限 | 呈降質樣貌：針對一般平民流量的行政限速，使倖存半區在國際軸線上呈現較接近 50% 降載的失效樣貌，而另一半區則無全球連外出口 |
| k3，強制重導向 | 流量可通但轉接至敵對者控制的基礎設施，使該半區的國際通訊面臨內容檢視與強制路徑選擇 |

en.md: Under every gateway kind, cross-partition domestic traffic remains unreachable, because the severed north–south trunks are the defining failure of the rung and carry no traffic regardless of gateway policy.

gemini.md: 在任何閘道類型下，跨分割區的國內流量皆保持不可達，因為切斷的南北幹線是該梯級的定義性失效，無論閘道政策為何皆無法傳輸流量。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson routing-isolation events document asymmetric access at sub-national scale: Kherson received limited connectivity via Crimea while non-occupied Ukrainian regions kept their own international paths, so two geographically distinct zones with different upstream providers operated simultaneously, and [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) and [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/) document the difference in routing geometry and the asymmetry in latency direction between them. *(Inference from the dComms roundtable, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The dComms roundtable identified the gateway failure kind (k1, k2, or k3) as the determinant of whether a surviving physical cable yields usable global egress. Taiwan transferability: structural. Because Taiwan's southern landing stations at Fangshan (枋山) are geographically separated from the northern stations, asymmetric physical survival of one station cluster is plausible under the physical triggers that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **前例。** *(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 赫爾松路由隔離事件記錄了次國家規模下的非對稱存取：赫爾松透過克里米亞獲得有限連線，而烏克蘭未遭佔領區域則保持各自的國際路徑，使得兩個擁有不同上游業者的地理獨立區域同時運作；[Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) 與 [RIPE Labs, Resilience of the Internet in Ukraine, One Year On, April 2023](https://labs.ripe.net/author/emileaben/the-resilience-of-the-internet-in-ukraine-one-year-on/) 記錄了兩者之間路由拓撲的差異與延遲方向的非對稱性。*(依據 dComms 圓桌會議（2026 年 6 月）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* dComms 圓桌會議指出閘道失效類型（k1、k2 或 k3）是決定存活實體海纜能否產生可用全球連外出口的關鍵因素。台灣適用性：結構性適用。由於台灣位於枋山的南部登陸站與北部登陸站在地理上相互分離，因此在產生島內分割的實體觸發條件下，單一登陸站群集的非對稱實體倖存具備合理性。

en.md: **Recognition discriminator.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation simulated-scenario definitions)* Versus Single-City Isolation, on geographic scope: Partial-Access Partition involves island-wide north–south trunk severance with asymmetric international access, whereas Single-City Isolation involves one municipality losing all upstream links while the domestic network in the rest of each half remains intact.

gemini.md: **辨識區分點。** *(依據部分連外分割與單城孤立模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 相較於單城孤立，差異在於地理範圍：部分連外分割涉及全島規模的南北幹線切斷並伴隨非對稱國際存取；而單城孤立則是單一市鎮失去所有上游連結，但各半區其餘部分的國內網路仍保持完好。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would vary the surviving half's gateway failure kind across runs (k1 administratively dark, k2 throttled, k3 adversary-surveilled, or open) and ask cross-functional teams, without access to out-of-scenario network information, which services and communication paths survive under each gateway condition.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演會在不同輪次中調整倖存半區的閘道失效類型（k1 行政斷網、k2 被限速、k3 遭敵對者監控或開放），並要求跨功能團隊在無法取得情境外網路資訊的情況下，評估在每種閘道狀況下有哪些服務與通訊路徑能夠存活。

en.md: #### Single-City Isolation

gemini.md: #### Single-City Isolation

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: one city, a municipality or urban area, loses all upstream links to the rest of the island's domestic network simultaneously, while the broader island network continues to operate within each half of the partition.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：單一城市（直轄市、縣市或都會區）同時失去了通往全島其餘國內網路的所有上游連結，而更廣泛的全島網路則在分割區的各個半區內繼續運作。

en.md: **Narrative shape.** A single physical event severs every upstream ingress link serving the city: a trunk failure along a geographic corridor, cable damage at a bridge or mountain pass, or the simultaneous loss of all last-mile aggregation points feeding the city. The domestic network elsewhere in each half continues to operate normally. From inside the city, every service hosted outside city boundaries is unreachable, including services on the rest of the island, which the rung's north–south partition already divides and the city's own upstream failure now cuts off entirely, and international services, which the concurrent Global Cutoff already removes. Services hosted within the city continue to serve local users on the city's internal network. Emergency responders in the city can therefore reach only city-local resources; coordination systems, databases, and communication paths hosted anywhere outside the city are as unreachable as foreign ones.

gemini.md: **情節輪廓。** 單一實體事件切斷了服務該城市的所有上游進站連結：沿地理走廊的幹線失效、橋樑或隘口處的纜線受損，或是為該城市提供連線的所有最後一哩彙集點同時喪失。各半區其他地方的國內網路繼續正常運作。從城市內部來看，託管於市界之外的所有服務皆不可達，包括全島其餘地方的服務（本梯級的南北分割已將其分開，而城市自身的上游失效現在更將其完全切斷），以及國際服務（同時發生的全球斷線已將其移除）。託管於城市內部的服務則繼續在城市的內部網路上為在地使用者提供服務。因此，城市內的緊急應變人員只能觸及城市在地資源；託管於城市之外任何地方的協調系統、資料庫與通訊路徑，皆與國外資源一樣不可達。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Inference from the Ukraine/Kherson occupied-territory routing analysis, RIPE Labs and Kentik, 2022–2024; not independently confirmed)* The Kherson case documents routing isolation at city scale: all of Kherson's internet access was rerouted through a single non-Ukrainian upstream, which made the city a routing zone disconnected from the Ukrainian domestic network, and [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) documents the BGP path change that produced this isolation. *(Inference from the dComms roundtable, June 2026; not independently confirmed)* The dComms roundtable identified Single-City Isolation as a drill-relevant scenario for civil-society and private-sector engineers reasoning about local service survival without out-of-city coordination. Taiwan transferability: the scenario requires only the simultaneous severance of a city's upstream long-haul fiber routes, which typically enter through a small number of trunk corridors and terrain chokepoints, and such severance is structurally plausible under the physical triggers that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **前例。** *(依據 Ukraine/Kherson 佔領區路由分析、RIPE Labs 與 Kentik（2022–2024）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* 赫爾松案例記錄了城市規模的路由隔離：赫爾松的所有網際網路存取皆被重導向至單一非烏克蘭上游，使該市成為與烏克蘭國內網路斷開的路由區域，而 [Kentik, Rerouting of Kherson follows familiar gameplan, August 2022](https://www.kentik.com/blog/rerouting-of-kherson-follows-familiar-gameplan/) 記錄了產生此隔離的 BGP 路徑變更。*(依據 dComms 圓桌會議（2026 年 6 月）所做的推論；未經獨立證實)* dComms 圓桌會議指出單城孤立是一個極具演練價值的情境，可供公民社會與民間企業工程師推理在缺乏城外協調的情況下在地服務如何存活。台灣適用性：該情境僅需同時切斷城市的上游長途光纖路徑，而這些路徑通常經過少數幹線走廊與地形瓶頸，因此在產生島內分割的實體觸發條件下，此類切斷在結構上具備合理性。

en.md: **Recognition discriminator.** *(Structural inference from the Partial-Access Partition and Single-City Isolation simulated-scenario definitions)* Versus Partial-Access Partition, on the extent of the domestic failure: Single-City Isolation does not require island-wide north–south trunk severance and can co-occur with intact domestic connectivity in every non-isolated part of each half, so its failure is confined to one municipality.

gemini.md: **辨識區分點。** *(依據部分連外分割與單城孤立模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 相較於部分連外分割，差異在於國內失效的程度：單城孤立不需要全島規模的南北幹線切斷，且可與各半區非孤立區域完好的國內連線共存，因此其失效僅局限於單一市鎮。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would restrict participants to a single-city information environment, in which only resources and communication paths physically present within city boundaries are accessible, and ask teams which locally hosted services, local coordination mechanisms, and local human-organizational paths remain functional when out-of-city network access is zero.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演會將參與者限制於單一城市的資訊環境中，其中僅能存取實體存在於市界內部的資源與通訊路徑，並要求團隊評估當城外網路存取歸零時，有哪些在地託管服務、在地協調機制與在地人與組織路徑仍可正常運作。

en.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

gemini.md: #### Site-Level Blackout

en.md: A simulated scenario under Island Partition: a single rescue, shelter, or critical-infrastructure site has no upstream connectivity whatsoever, because its last-mile links are completely severed, leaving it an isolated on-site network with no path to any external node on the domestic network or the global internet.

gemini.md: 島內分割下的一種模擬情境：單一搜救、庇護所或關鍵基礎設施站點完全沒有任何上游連線，因為其最後一哩連結已被完全切斷，使其成為孤立的現場網路，無法連接至國內網路或全球網際網路上的任何外部節點。

en.md: **Narrative shape.** The site's last-mile connections to all upstream providers are severed simultaneously by cut fiber, destroyed antenna installations, or loss of the power supply that sustains its radio links. The site's internal network continues to operate: devices reach each other, and locally hosted services and locally cached data remain accessible. No packet crosses the site boundary in either direction. Staff cannot reach emergency coordination systems hosted elsewhere, verify instructions from external authorities, transmit status reports, or access any live data source outside the site. Every digital resource that the site depended on but did not host, such as patient records, authorization systems, real-time operational data, and software updates, is unreachable, and the site's only working network resources are those that were present and operational on site before the last-mile link failed.

gemini.md: **情節輪廓。** 站點至所有上游提供者的最後一哩連線因光纖遭切斷、天線設施遭摧毀或維持無線電連結的電力中斷而同時切斷。站點的內部網路繼續運作：裝置之間可以互通，在地託管的服務與在地快取的資料仍可存取。封包無法往任一方向跨越站點邊界。工作人員無法觸及託管於他處的緊急協調系統、無法驗證外部主管機關的指示、無法傳送狀態報告，也無法存取站點外的任何即時資料源。站點所依賴但未在地託管的所有數位資源（如病歷紀錄、授權系統、即時維運資料與軟體更新）皆不可達，站點唯一能運作的網路資源僅剩最後一哩連結失效前已存在於現場且正常運作的資源。

en.md: **Precedent.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the site-connectivity premise of the simulated scenario)* Site-Level Blackout is entailed by the Island Partition rung definition: if partition and global cutoff together sever all paths external to each half, a site whose last-mile links are also severed within that half has no path to any external node by construction. No primary source documents an event at exactly this scale, a single rescue or shelter site with complete last-mile severance under simultaneous Island Partition conditions, so the precedent is grounded in mechanism rather than incident. The war in Ukraine offers a partial illustration at comparable granularity: individual Starlink terminals were the sole connectivity path for some frontline sites, and their loss or suppression left those sites with no electronic communication path to any outside node ([Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)). Taiwan transferability: direct. Any critical site in Taiwan that depends on a single last-mile connection path is susceptible to this pattern under the physical conditions that produce Island Partition.

gemini.md: **前例。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義與模擬情境的站點連線前提所做的結構性推論)* 站點全斷由島內分割梯級定義所推導出：若分割與全球斷線共同切斷了各半區外部的所有路徑，則在該半區內最後一哩連結亦遭切斷的站點，在結構上必然無法連接任何外部節點。尚無一手資料記錄完全在此規模下的事件（即在同時發生島內分割的條件下，單一搜救或庇護所站點遭完全切斷最後一哩），因此前例是建構於機制而非單一事件。烏克蘭戰爭在可比的粒度上提供了一部分說明：個人 Starlink 終端是某些前線站點唯一的連線路徑，其喪失或遭干擾使這些站點失去了通往任何外部節點的電子通訊路徑（[Cloudflare Blog, One Year of War in Ukraine, February 2023](https://blog.cloudflare.com/one-year-of-war-in-ukraine/)）。台灣適用性：直接適用。台灣任何依賴單一最後一哩連線路徑的關鍵站點，在產生島內分割的實體條件下皆容易呈現此模式。

en.md: **Recognition discriminator.** *(Structural inference from the Island Partition rung definition and the Site-Level Blackout simulated-scenario definition)* Versus Single-City Isolation, on the BGP and routing-plane axis: Single-City Isolation produces a routing-plane event for the city's upstream AS paths, observable in route-collector data, and a probe-visible zero-reachability signature from within the city's address space, whereas Site-Level Blackout produces neither, because a site with no upstream connectivity does not participate in the routing table.

gemini.md: **辨識區分點。** *(依據島內分割梯級定義與站點全斷模擬情境定義所做的結構性推論)* 相較於單城孤立，在 BGP 與路由平面軸線上的差異為：單城孤立會針對城市的上游 AS 路徑產生路由平面事件（可在路由收集器資料中觀察到），並從城市位址空間內部產生探針可見的零可達性特徵；而站點全斷則兩者皆不會產生，因為缺乏上游連線的站點不會參與路由表。

en.md: **Drill note.** A tabletop exercise for this scenario would give responders a single-site information environment, with no external network access and only locally cached data and local communication paths, and ask which operational decisions can be made from local resources alone, which require out-of-site coordination that is unreachable, and which resources would need to be present at the site before the last-mile link failed.

gemini.md: **演練備註。** 針對此情境的桌上推演會給予應變人員單一站點的資訊環境，完全無外部網路存取，僅有在地快取的資料與在地通訊路徑，並要求評估哪些維運決策可僅憑在地資源做決定、哪些需要不可達的站點外協調，以及哪些資源需要在最後一哩連結失效前預先部署於站點現場。

The report defines a Threat context as a geopolitical or natural condition (peacetime accident, blockade/being surrounded, PLA landing, mega-quake) discussed in the Background chapter only, and treats it as causally decoupled from the disruption scenarios: any Threat context might produce any disruption scenario, or none.
